content.rendered:
School Boundaries

Use the Boundary Map to locate schools and residences within the Sherwood School District Boundary. To search, enter an address in the upper left corner. If an address is not located or is outside of the boundary map, please contact Carrie Mower at cmower@sherwood.k12.or.us or call the District Office at 503-825-5000.

Enrollment – New Students

Online enrollment is accessible at https://bit.ly/SSD-OLR

Students who completed the 2024-2025 school year in Sherwood School District automatically rollover to the 2025-2026 school year. This includes Pre-K students.

Paper-based enrollment forms are available in the Paper-Based Enrollment Forms section below.

New families will create a ParentVue account during online enrollment. If your family is new to the Sherwood School District, please answer NO to the following online enrollment questions.

  • Do you currently have a student enrolled in the Sherwood School District? NO
  • Have you ever had a student enrolled in the Sherwood School District? NO
  • Do you have a ParentVue account with the Sherwood School District? NO

Current and returning families will log in with their existing ParentVUE account. For assistance with your Activation Key or ParentVue login, please email Kami Golden at kgolden@sherwood.k12.or.us or call 503-825-5011.

Online enrollment requires the upload of specific documents. If you do not have the requested information, upload a document or photo that says you will provide the information before school begins. Documents may be submitted in person or by email to the appropriate school enrollment contact below.

School Enrollment Contacts

Email enrollment documents to the contact below:

  • Archer Glen Elementary – Jennifer Switzer, jswitzer@sherwood.k12.or.us
  • Hawks View Elementary – Kellie Johnson, kmjohnson@sherwood.k12.or.us
  • Middleton Elementary – Michelle Wunnicke, mwunnicke@sherwood.k12.or.us
  • Ridges Elementary – Kelley Heckendorn, kheckendorn@sherwood.k12.or.us
  • Sherwood Middle School – Allison Kopp, akopp@sherwood.k12.or.us
  • Sherwood High School – Tracie Harbick, tharbick@sherwood.k12.or.us

For assistance with enrollment questions or a ParentVue login/activation key, please contact:

  • District Office – Kami Golden, kgolden@sherwood.k12.or.us, 503-825-5011

Paper-Based Enrollment Forms

Enrollment forms are available at each school and the District Office located at 21920 SW Sherwood Blvd.

Enrollment Steps

1. Identify your Child’s School

Locate the school for your residential address using our online Boundary Map.

2. Provide the Required Documents

  • Proof of Address: 2 items from the list below
    • Mortgage Statement
    • Property Tax Statement
    • Rental Lease Agreement
    • Utility Bill (electricity, gas, water/sewer)
    • Oregon Driver’s License
    • Oregon Identification Card
  • Proof of Birth (Birth Certificate or Passport)
  • Immunization Records

Public schools are obligated to enroll students regardless of their immigration status and without discrimination on the basis of race, color or national origin.

3. Complete the Registration Forms

Complete the appropriate registration forms.

4. Submit Completed Paperwork

Completed forms and documents may be submitted in person or by email to the appropriate school.

  • Archer Glen Elementary – Jennifer Switzer, jswitzer@sherwood.k12.or.us
  • Hawks View Elementary – Kellie Johnson, kmjohnson@sherwood.k12.or.us
  • Middleton Elementary – Michelle Wunnicke, mwunnicke@sherwood.k12.or.us
  • Ridges Elementary – Kelley Heckendorn, kheckendorn@sherwood.k12.or.us
  • Sherwood Middle School – Allison Kopp, akopp@sherwood.k12.or.us
  • Sherwood High School – Tracie Harbick, tharbick@sherwood.k12.or.us
